goal: Prevent invalid items in batch RPC requests from reusing the prior item ID or dropping error replies
Ensure batch RPC clients receive valid, spec-compliant error responses
agreement: Concept support for fixing spec compliance that could confuse batch RPC clients (pinheadmz)
Suggestions to clean up duplicate resets and improve test coverage were resolved (pinheadmz, AndreaDiazCorreia)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an edge case where invalid batch elements misattribute IDs or drop error replies
Ensures JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance for batch clients, but only affects malformed request inputs
